description: This file defines the PopupSmarty class, which extends ListViewSmarty to implement a popup list view in the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment. It includes methods for processing data, rendering templates, handling search forms, and managing UI elements for popup-based record selection.

classes.name: PopupSmarty
classes.description: A class for managing popup list views with Smarty templates in SuiteCRM/SugarCRM, including data processing, template rendering, search management, and UI controls.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PopupSmarty instance, sets up templates, module info, and search form.

methods.name: processArrowVars
methods.description: Assigns image attributes for arrow icons used in sorting.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes data to prepare the list view, assigns template variables, and handles multi-select and context menu setup.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the Smarty template with data and UI components for the popup list view.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the list view, including order, filters, and search setup.

methods.name: _setup
methods.description: Performs detailed setup tasks such as including metadata and search fields.

methods.name: _get_where_clause
methods.description: Constructs SQL WHERE clause based on search form inputs and metadata.

methods.name: _build_field_defs
methods.description: Prepares the search form field definitions and their current values.

methods.name: _getAddForm
methods.description: Generates HTML for the quick create form based on metadata.

methods.name: _getAddFormHeader
methods.description: Creates the header HTML for the quick create form, including hidden fields.

methods.name: getQuickCreate
methods.description: Returns HTML for the quick create popup using the PopupQuickCreate class.
